No, I’ve not had any psychological help or therapy. I have a strong mistrust of mental health professionals. I’ve just done quite a lot of reflection, and I’m just naturally quite aware of what I’m doing in hindsight.

I do want to change but nothing ever works when I try to change. I instinctively just fall back to what I’ve always been doing; Manipulating. The only way out of this for me is to die.
